findings: Inner Q mask checked only against retained q_profile: implement inspect_cases builds qpos from case['adapter']['q_profile'] (~line 213) and compares c_done to _mask(invoked,qpos) (~lines 188-192) without pinning q_profile to the canonical subprofile; originals require exact(qp,subprofile(profile)) (a_audit.py ~line 15) and reject 'moved-potential-Q-occurrence'/'renumbered-Q-occurrence-positions' (adapter_traces.py restore control; check.py ~line 213). No control probe mutates q_profile. Fixture: adapter trace with q_profile['actions'] reversed and initial core.done plus every core patch rewritten under that order, outer evidence untouched — passes both artifacts. Fix: recompute the potential-action set from profile['actions'] via the source_only verb-prefix rule (pure string test, no import), require equality, add a renumbered-q-profile probe.

Control inspect_cases can crash instead of its documented 'uninspectable' outcome: intact (control-build ~lines 77-85) never screens trace['initial'] or profile['requires'], yet _done (~line 60) dereferences trace['initial']['done'] and the dependency check (~line 118) dereferences profile['requires']; non-string action literals also escape screening and break set(actions[:p-1]). Fixture: well-formed events/actions with source 'initial' absent — KeyError propagates through inspect_cases/run_controls. Fix: extend intact (dict initial with int done, dict requires, str literals) or wrap the prefix loop.

Stated finite precharge violated by witness search: docstring claims charge.take(1) before every case-level structural read (~line 33), but run_controls.find (~lines 144-153) reads case['source']['actions']/profile and evaluates _mask predicates over all (case,prefix) pairs uncharged before any probe inspection; search repeats are also free. Finite but unaccounted. Fix: charge.take(1) per candidate case inside find.

Dropped original premises and weak checker binding: implement never compares adapter['profile'] to source['profile'] though original audit_case requires exact equality (check.py audit_case); rows/prefixes optional, so 'supported' can be returned with all row/q_invocation/prefix-index checks skipped (limitation note only); run_controls (~line 140) accepts any inspect_cases — injecting the module-local weaker checker yields identical detected tallies, so control output does not evidence which checker ran. Fix: require profile equality, degrade status when rows/prefixes absent, record checker identity per control.
